notes: system_map sends GET /v1/locations and decodes the keyed LocationSystemMap response.

Source disagreement: OpenAPI exposes location and scanned fields, while the rendered page shows code, surveyed, and top-level boolean atmosphere (reference/replicant-space-2-5-1/api/locations/index.md:73). The client aliases code and surveyed but retains atmosphere only as Option<String> inside PlanetaryBody.

The legacy route is explicitly deprecated in the rendered inventory page and the public client policy excludes deprecated operations (reference/replicant-space-2-5-1/api/locations/inventory/index.md:19).
stars_near encodes the star path parameter, sends page and per_page, and decodes StarListResponse.

Source disagreement: OpenAPI omits a success schema, while rendered scan-device docs define a 200 body containing star, device_count, devices, and next_cursor (reference/replicant-space-2-5-1/api/replicants/scan/devices/index.md:41). The client sends all filters but returns a generic JSON value instead of a typed response.
catalogue sends the authenticated GET, applies the dedicated catalogue response limit, and decodes CatalogueResponse.

Source disagreement: OpenAPI declares no success response for this POST, while the rendered megastructure page documents a 200 object with accepted, rejected, progress, and status (reference/replicant-space-2-5-1/api/locations/megastructures/index.md:62). The client sends the required devices body but returns a generic JSON value rather than a typed success shape.

Source disagreement: OpenAPI defines replicants as an array of objects, while rendered scan docs show an object keyed by replicant name (reference/replicant-space-2-5-1/api/replicants/scan/index.md:104). SystemScanResponse follows the OpenAPI array and cannot decode the rendered object shape.
The simple wire error string is normalized into message and retained only through the broader sanitized error envelope rather than exposed as a serde error field.
Position exposes x, y, and z as the contract's numeric coordinate fields.
LocationContributionRequest serializes the required devices string array with the documented wire name.
LocationCounts represents devices, location_events, replicants, resource_sites, and resources as integer fields.
LocationSystemMap represents the locations object as a map from designation to LocationCounts.
ScanLocationEvent models designation, event_type, location, tier, and title with the documented wire names and scalar types.
The resources property is exposed as generic JsonObject rather than a map whose values are constrained to strings.
ScanAsteroidBelt models the belts array of ScanAsteroidBeltDetail and the present boolean.
ScanHabitableZone models inner_au and outer_au as numeric boundaries.
ScanInventoryItem models quantity as a number and resource_type as a string.
ScanPlanetSummary includes every contract property, including typed inventory and open-shaped salvage arrays.
ScanShopSummary models all shop identity, nullable description and location_name, ownership, and typed trades fields.
ScanShopTrade models the open criteria and rewards objects together with current_stock, name, and trade_code.
ScanStarDetail models all stellar measurements, identity fields, position, habitable zone, and temperature.

Source disagreement: OpenAPI defines replicants as an array of objects, while rendered scan docs show an object keyed by replicant name (reference/replicant-space-2-5-1/api/replicants/scan/index.md:104). The public field is Vec<JsonObject>, so it follows OpenAPI and cannot decode the documented object.
CatalogueResponse models generated_at, the typed stars array, and total.
StarDetailResponse models replicant_position and the requested StarItem detail.
StarListResponse models pagination, replicant_position, typed stars, total, total_pages, and total_stars.
